text: Welcome to the wonderful world of reading. In this I Can Read story, Pete the Kitty's Outdoor Art Project, you will be going on a fun adventure. Are you ready to read? Here we go! Music It is time for art class! Pete the Kitty cannot wait! Pete loves art class. He likes to draw, he likes to paint, and clay is super groovy. Pete opens the door. Something is not the same. Pete does not see paper. He does not see paint. Pete sees a bag on his desk. Pete looks inside the bag. It is empty! Why does Pete have a bag? A bag is not art. The teacher says, Today we are going outside. We will make art from what we find in nature. Cool! says Callie. Nifty says Abby. But Pete does not think it is cool. Pete does not think it is nifty. Pete wants to paint or draw. He is not sure grass can make good art. Pete and his class go outside. There is a lot to see. Pete sees a leaf. The leaf is groovy. Pete puts the leaf in his bag. Pete sees a flower. The flower is awesome. He puts the flower in his bag. Pete sees a stick. The stick is cool. He puts the stick in his bag. Nifty thinks. But Pete still does not think that they are art. Pete looks at Callie. She is making a flower crown. Pete likes the crown. It is fun. Pete looks at Abby. She is making a small turtle out of leaves and a pine cone. Pete grins. He did not know that leaves could look that way. Pete looks back down at his bag. He has a lot of flowers. He has a lot of sticks. He even has an acorn. Pete knows what to do. Now Pete is happy. It will be very cool. Pete starts with sticks. He uses some flower petals. Pete adds grass and leaves. Finally he is done. Pete holds up his art. He made a butterfly. I love it, Callie says. Very rad, Abby says. Good work, says the teacher. Pete smiles. He did not know nature art could be so fun.
